source.description: Source name of the file or directory to move. Source must be local to the current directory.

function.name: tail
function.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Display the last part of a file of any extension. lines.description: The number of lines to display from the end of the file. Defaults to 10.

file_name.description: The name of the new file in the current directory. file_name is local to the current directory and does not allow path.

type.description: The type of unit we are counting. [Enum]: ["lines", "words", "characters"]
